subject: 39 Taft Street Residential Addition
overview: The board approved a special permit for a residential expansion on Taft Street and adjusted its meeting schedule for the upcoming holiday season.

items.title: 39 Taft Street Special Permit
items.summary: Approved a special permit for 39 Taft Street to allow a second-story addition and side extensions on a pre-existing non-conforming single-family home.

items.title: Administrative Items and Scheduling
items.summary: Tabled the July meeting minutes, rescheduled the October and November meetings to avoid holiday conflicts, and received an update on drafting new board rules and regulations.
